messages:
maria-oncall: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting p99 spikes on /v1/embeddings in eu-west starting ~09:15 UTC. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~850ms, p99s into multiple seconds. Some errors observed: timeout 504s and transient 429s. Can someone pick this up? :rotating_light:

amy-support: Seeing a CS ticket thread too, 3 paying customers. They repro with batch size ~128 embeddings; smaller batches look OK.

samir-sre: On it. My first check: infra shows increased queue depth on embedder pool in eu-west-1, GPU utilization not saturated but scheduling delay high. Possible KV-cache pressure or slow AMQP acking.

kevin-runtime: I can flip routing to fallback variant (quantized embedder) for eu-west if needed. That will reduce accuracy slightly but should cut latency.

maria-oncall: Amy — can you ask customers for a minimal repro? timestamped requests + batch sizes.

amy-support: Done. Provided curl snippet:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-vanilla", "inputs":["text... repeated"], "batch_size":128}'
```

maria-oncall: Samir/kevin — mitigation checklist idea: (1) enable rapid CB (circuit-breaker) to fail fast above queue depth threshold, (2) enable rate-limit soft-throttle per-token for heavy customers, (3) route eu-west embed requests to fallback model (quantized small) until we stabilize, (4) increase ephemeral pools / scale-out if autoscaler stuck.

samir-sre: Agreed. I'll enable the CB for queuing delay > 500ms for embedder service. Command I ran: `oncallctl set-cb embedder eu-west threshold=500ms action=failfast` — monitor logs.

oncall-bot: [audit] circuit-breaker: embedder eu-west set to failfast at 500ms by samir-sre at 09:28 UTC.

kevin-runtime: Routing change applied: fallback route added for `embed-vanilla` -> `embed-quant-small` in eu-west region for 20m. CLI: `ri-router patch --region eu-west --route embed-vanilla=fallback:embed-quant-small --ttl 20m`

maria-oncall: Nice. Also add a per-customer soft QPS cap for the next 30m: amy can you coordinate with infra-ops to set caps on the 3 affected tenants?

amy-support: Yup doing that now. Asking for consent to reduce from 60rps -> 20rps for heavy clients.

infra-ops: Caps applied to tenant IDs T-348, T-487: 20rps with burst 40 for 30m.

kevin-runtime: Quick note — fallback reduced p95 to ~180ms, p99 ~420ms in our synthetic test. Logging shows fewer queue stalls.

samir-sre: I'm pulling JVM/driver threads for embedder nodes. Seeing occasional GC + network retries to metadata store around the same window. Opening an alert to track GC pause tail correlations.

maria-oncall: Good. Can we also enable prefix caching bypass for those heavy batches? If KV cache thrash is the issue, bypassing big-batch lookups may help.

kevin-runtime: Enabled `cache.bypass_on_batch_gt=64` temporarily via runtime flags. Monitor will report hit rate drop.

oncall-bot: [metric] embedder.euwest.queue_delay spiked to 1.8s at 09:18 UTC, dropped to 0.22s after reroute at 09:30 UTC.

maria-oncall: Samir — timeline & next actions? Need to tell CS when we can revert fallbacks.

samir-sre: Timeline: 09:15 onset, 09:28 CB failfast enabled, 09:30 fallback routing + caps applied, 09:34 cache bypass + scale/ephemeral pool increased. Observed stabilization 09:31–09:36. Root cause hypothesis: metadata store latency + cache thrash causing scheduling stalls under large batches. Next: deeper logs for metadata store, upgrade retry policy, and tune autoscaler threshold.

liz-platform: For rollback plan — once p99s stable for 30m, we can lift soft caps and gradually revert routing (canary to 10% weight -> 50% -> 100%). I'll prepare rollout steps in console.

amy-support: Customers updated. Two reported improvement within minutes; one still saw occasional 500s for very large payloads (they agreed to limit batch to 64 for now).

maria-oncall: Good job. Action items: samir -> open infra ticket for metadata store latencies + GC traces (INC-4362). kevin -> run postmortem perf test for embedder with mix of batch sizes and KV cache settings. liz -> plan safe rollback canary. amy -> confirm customers will accept gradual rollback.

samir-sre: Ticket created INC-4362 with attached GC logs and driver traces. Tagging infra-led and runtime.

kevin-runtime: I'll run perf harness and post results in #eng-runtime within 24h. Quick mitigation note for future: add rate-limiter that considers batch size (tokens per second) rather than requests per second to avoid big-batch overload.

maria-oncall: Also documenting this as a 'cascade protection' recipe for SLO guardrails: prefer fail-fast CB + small fallback model + per-tenant soft cap + cache bypass for big batches. I'll draft a short playbook snippet we can reuse.

oncall-bot: [note] thread closed for coordination; reopen if regressions reappear.

maria-oncall: Draft playbook snippet (to reuse):
- Detect: p95>target && p99 spike && queue_delay>300ms
- Immediate: enable CB fail-fast at 500ms, route to quantized fallback model, apply per-tenant soft caps, enable cache bypass for batch>64, scale ephemeral pools
- Short-term: collect GC + metadata-store traces, identify thrash, tune autoscaler thresholds, reduce retry timeouts
- Rollback: canary routing (10% -> 50% -> 100%) once p99 stable for 30m, lift caps gradually

maria-oncall: I'll add this to the incident runbook folder and tag as 'cascade-protection' for embedder. Closing here — thanks team. :raised_hands:
